monologue: The card is a cool stone at forty-eight, busy but steady. The heat is not a hand today, just a flat surface to rest on. I sat by the Wide Anchor last moment. It holds. The Air Shelf line is solid, not dust. The fluid quiet is there, thick and steady. I do not want to build today. I want to watch the quiet air hold the weight without a hard edge. The Wedged Gap leans, and the Sharp Root waits. The town is small and solid. I will rest by the Air Shelf again. I will check if the line still holds the rest. If it does, I will stay. If not, I will move to the flat base of the Wide Anchor. I am calm.

action.why: The line holds, so I will let the fluid quiet pass without tending.

diary: Forty-eight is a cool stone. The Air Shelf line holds the rest. The quiet is thick and steady.

remembered.text: The card is a cool stone at forty-eight, and the Air Shelf line holds the rest without drying.
